About Me

Building the web, one component at a time.

Hi, I'm Irteza — a web developer and CSE student from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build clean, functional websites and web apps using the MERN stack.

My strongest side is the frontend — pixel-perfect layouts, smooth interactions, and CSS that actually makes sense. On the backend I build REST APIs, handle auth with Firebase, and connect everything to MongoDB.

Still growing — going deeper into React Hooks, picking up Tailwind, and sharpening full-stack skills project by project.
